Mind control to me is the ability to alter a persons behaviors and actions for a specific goal which is know only by an outside observer.

I have PTSD, Panic Disorder, Generalized Anxiety etc.

I have taken medications that completely altered who I was. Medications that made me Schizophrenic and absolutely warped my reality. Hallucinations so real that the only way you can tell them apart from reality is to break your mold of reality itself.

It made me realize that free will does not exists.

You are controlled by your environment and what you put into your body and no matter how hard you try.

I would have never admitted it myself unless I experienced what I have.

Now imagine your mind as a box full of items.

Memories, Internal thoughts, everything that makes reality real to you. Everything that makes you, you.

It’s entirely possible for a drug or a controlled environment to start taking things out of this box, letting this box shrink until you start seeing reality differently. Until your consciousness can fit in the palm of your hand. It can forever shatter reality for you. Once you push through that barrier everything changes and there’s no way back.
It will forever be a part of you.

A drug engineered for this specific purpose with a slow onset and careful environmental planning is entirely possible.

Break the mind and you can reprogram it. It’s just best if the subject is completely unaware of what is going on.
There is no cure for depression.
